script.code:
SELECT CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, h.item_assembly_status, h.stock_movement_no,
       IF('{{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.trRead}}' = 'YES' OR h.item_assembly_status <> 'Draft',
          (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT(
                       'reqs', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(rq.id AS CHAR), 'no', rq.stock_movement_no, 'status', rq.stock_movement_status,
                                        'bin', CAST(rd.location_id AS CHAR), 'bin_name', rb.bin_location_combine))
                                  FROM sm_location_transfer rq
                                 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MIN(rl.id) AS first_id FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub rl
                                                      WHERE rl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.tenantId}}' AND rl.sm_location_transfer_id = rq.id AND rl.is_deleted = 0) rx
                                  LEFT JOIN sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub rd ON rd.id = rx.first_id
                                  LEFT JOIN bin_location rb ON rb.id = rd.location_id
                                 WHERE rq.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.tenantId}}' AND rq.is_deleted = 0 AND rq.transfer_purpose = 'IA_SUPPLY' AND rq.source_ia_id = '{{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.iaId}}'),
                       'items', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(ri.id AS CHAR), 'stock_control', ri.stock_control,
                                         'serial_number_management', ri.serial_number_management))
                                   FROM item ri WHERE ri.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.tenantId}}' AND ri.is_deleted = 0 AND ri.id IN ({{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.trItems}}))) AS CHAR)),
          NULL) AS iatr
  FROM sm_item_assembly h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IAguardIn.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
       'member', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blade_dept p
          WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCin.data.tenantId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND {{node:code_node_SCin.data.org}} > 0 AND (p.id = {{node:code_node_SCin.data.org}} OR FIND_IN_SET('{{node:code_node_SCin.data.org}}',
		p.ancestors) > 0)
            AND FIND_IN_SET(CAST(p.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_id, '') FROM blade_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCin.data.tenantId}}' AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.id = {{node:code_node_SCin.data.uid}} LIMIT 1)) > 0),
       'stored', IF(h.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('source_so_id', h.source_so_id, 'source_so_line_id', h.source_so_line_id,
         'source_so_context_json', h.source_so_context_json, 'bom_consumption_mode', h.bom_consumption_mode, 'source_bom_id', h.source_bom_id,
         'bom_snapshot_json', h.bom_snapshot_json, 'planned_output_qty', CAST(h.planned_output_qty AS CHAR), 'item_id', h.item_id,
         'output_split', h.output_split, 'plant', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR), 'bin', CAST(h.location_id AS CHAR))),
       'line', IF(l.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'sales_order_id', CAST(l.sales_order_id AS CHAR),
         'item_name', l.item_name, 'so_quantity', CAST(l.so_quantity AS CHAR), 'so_item_uom', CAST(l.so_item_uom AS CHAR),
         'delivered_qty', CAST(l.delivered_qty AS CHAR), 'line_status', l.line_status, 'is_deleted', l.is_deleted, 'line_index', l.line_index)),
       'header', IF(s.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'so_no', s.so_no, 'so_status', s.so_status,
         'organization_id', s.organization_id, 'customer_id', CAST(s.customer_name AS CHAR), 'is_deleted', s.is_deleted)),
       'hold', h.material_hold_status,
       'keys', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'k', x.sc_ref_key, 'r', CAST(x.required_qty AS CHAR), 'q', CAST(x.requested_qty AS CHAR),
                'm', x.required_manual)) FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCin.data.tenantId}}' AND x.id IN ({{node:code_node_SCin.data.lineIds}}) AND x.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_SCin.data.iaId}} AND x.is_deleted = 0)) AS j
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) d
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly h ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCin.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_SCin.data.iaId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l ON l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCin.data.tenantId}}'
   AND l.id = IF({{node:code_node_SCin.data.lineId}} > 0, {{node:code_node_SCin.data.lineId}}, IF(h.source_so_line_id REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$', CAST(h.source_so_line_id AS UNSIGNED),
		0))
  LEFT JOIN sales_order s ON s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCin.data.tenantId}}' AND s.id = l.sales_order_id
